title: A boundedness result for degenerate parabolic Riesz transforms with rough coefficients
summary: In this paper, we prove a boundedness result for parabolic Riesz transforms in the range $p \le 2$ associated with degenerate parabolic operators whose elliptic part is in divergence form with complex coefficients depending measurably on space and time. The degeneracy is determined by a spatial weight in the Muckenhoupt class $A_2(\mathbb{R}^n)$. The argument relies on off-diagonal estimates for the parabolic gradient of the resolvent family, together with weighted embeddings.
